exposure: Dilatation of the cervix at admission
outcome: Successful trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 1066 women with singleton, cephalic pregnancies and one previous low-transverse cesarean section delivery from five hospitals in China between 2018 and 2019.
finding: A nomogram incorporating maternal age, gestational week, height, previous vaginal delivery, Bishop score, cervical dilatation at admission, BMI at delivery, and fetal abdominal circumference by ultrasound demonstrated good predictive accuracy for VBAC.
